purpose: Classify every frozen-A Dev outcome without observing any B or C trajectory or outcome.

official_pass.definition: Generation and qualification complete, Official evaluation completes normally, and Official Pass is true.

official_fail.definition: Generation and qualification complete, Official evaluation completes normally, and Official Pass is false.

agent_noncompletion.definition: The Agent exhausts its operational limit, times out, or terminates without an admissible submitted program, with no infrastructure censoring evidence.

qualification_fail.definition: The Agent submits a program, but the exact program fails frozen post-session qualification before Official evaluation.

infrastructure_unknown.definition: Network, provider, host suspension, source acquisition, container, or evaluator infrastructure prevents a valid algorithmic outcome.

observation.question: Did the Agent fail to obtain or correctly read decisive execution evidence?

constraint.question: Was decisive evidence available, but converted into an incorrect or incomplete requirement or conflict?

operation.question: Was the relevant requirement understood, but the selected state transition, state reuse, or final program failed to satisfy it?

cross-layer.question: Do at least two independently necessary failures from different layers remain, with no single supported primary bottleneck?

unresolved.question: Is the available A-only evidence insufficient for a causal classification?

inputs_allowed: Frozen-A submitted program and hidden qualification
Frozen-A Official result and residual missing imports
Repository metadata visible to Frozen A
inputs_forbidden: Whether a proposed EnvSolve-Pro change repairs the case
Official Test or Canary content and outcomes
adjudication_rules.primary_failure_rule: Assign exactly one primary layer only when the evidence supports the earliest counterfactual bottleneck whose removal would plausibly change the terminal outcome. Otherwise assign cross-layer or unresolved.
adjudication_rules.secondary_tags: Up to three frozen subtypes may be retained as secondary contributors.
adjudication_rules.evidence_requirement: Every non-unresolved assignment must cite exact command sequence identifiers, verifier observations, qualification evidence, or Official residual modules.
adjudication_rules.novel_mechanism_policy: Map to unresolved/novel-mechanism-held-for-taxonomy-v2 until the complete census is closed.

batch_selection.stratum_order: Descending census frequency, then lexical stratum identifier.
batch_selection.selection_algorithm: Round-robin over ordered nonempty strata, taking the next ranked case from each stratum until 12 unique cases are selected or all eligible cases are exhausted.
selection_inputs_forbidden: Expected ease of improving a case
batch_selection.remaining_cases: All unselected eligible bad cases form the frozen validation pool and cannot be used to design the first core algorithm.
